app.label: App
app.description: A Convex app: a convex/ directory with defineApp.

component.label: Component
component.description: A Convex component, mounted by an app or by another component.

envVar.label: Env var
envVar.description: An environment variable a component or an app declares.

function.label: Function
function.description: A registered query, mutation, action, or HTTP action.

hook.label: React hook
hook.description: A React hook of the core or of a sign-in method.

httpRoute.label: HTTP route
httpRoute.description: A route of a component's HTTP router.

method.label: Sign-in method
method.description: A sign-in method of Convex Auth (methods/<name>).

methodFunction.label: Method function
methodFunction.description: An app function a setup… function returns, as the library defines it.

module.label: Client module
module.description: A module of the browser or SSR code.

setupFunction.label: Setup function
setupFunction.description: A setup… function: the app calls it to get its auth functions.

table.label: Table
table.description: A table of a component's or an app's schema.

thirdParty.label: Third party
thirdParty.description: A service outside the project that the code talks to.

calls.label: calls
calls.description: Calls a function through ctx.runQuery, runMutation, or runAction.

callsChildComponent.label: calls component
callsChildComponent.description: Calls a child component through its client library.

callsThirdParty.label: calls third party
callsThirdParty.description: Calls a library that talks to a third party.

clientCalls.label: client calls
clientCalls.description: Client code calls an app function.

definedBy.label: defined by
definedBy.description: An app function is the one a sign-in method's setup… returns.

fetches.label: fetches
fetches.description: Fetches a URL of a third party.

referencesFunction.label: references
referencesFunction.description: Names a function without calling it: passes it on, or makes a handle.

routesTo.label: routes to
routesTo.description: An HTTP route is served by a handler.

usesMethod.label: uses method
usesMethod.description: An app sets up a sign-in method by calling its setup… function.
